estimators.ratio: §47 G-stall: mem_used arm max insert vs k x len arm (no ratio gate)
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.placement_rule: poller on the first CPU of the first core; writers on the first CPU of every other core, then their SMT siblings, then the poller's sibling

G_stall.rule: per (shape, workload): PASS iff ci_upper(mem_used max insert) <= 3 x ci_upper(len max insert); FAIL iff ci_lower(mem_used max insert) > 3 x ci_upper(len max insert); INTERMEDIATE otherwise; the run is PASS iff all are, FAIL iff any is
